execution.label: Localize campaign banner
execution.description: Translate text-layer strings with Anthropic when needed, then run a Photoshop Actions UXP script that rewrites matching text layers in the PSD.

texts.description: Map of PSD text-layer name to source string to translate.

headline.description: Optional single string applied to every text layer not listed in texts.

prompt.$expr: (state) => `Translate every string value in this JSON into locale "${state.locale}". Keep the same JSON shape and keys. Return only JSON, no markdown.\n${JSON.stringify({ texts: state.texts || {}, headline: state.headline ?? null })}`

input.system: You translate PSD text-layer copy. Reply with a single raw JSON object only. No markdown fences, no commentary.

texts.$expr: (state) => { if (state.locale === 'en' || !(state.translation && state.translation.text)) return state.texts || {}; const raw = String(state.translation.text); const fenced = raw.match(/```(?:json)?\s*([\s\S]*?)```/i); const candidate = ((fenced && fenced[1]) || raw).trim(); try { const parsed = JSON.parse(candidate || '{}'); return parsed.texts && typeof parsed.texts === 'object' ? parsed.texts : (state.texts || {}); } catch { return state.texts || {}; } }

headline.$expr: (state) => { if (state.locale === 'en' || !(state.translation && state.translation.text)) return state.headline ?? null; const raw = String(state.translation.text); const fenced = raw.match(/```(?:json)?\s*([\s\S]*?)```/i); const candidate = ((fenced && fenced[1]) || raw).trim(); try { const parsed = JSON.parse(candidate || '{}'); return parsed.headline !== undefined ? parsed.headline : (state.headline ?? null); } catch { return state.headline ?? null; } }
